patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I doubled the weights, skipped the water, and at two in the morning my calf turned into a fist. It's better now but it frightened the life out of me.
clinical.presentationShort: 44yo F — self-limiting nocturnal calf cramp after unaccustomed exercise. Calf soft and non-tender, no swelling or asymmetry.
clinical.presentationLong: 44-year-old female with a self-limiting night-time calf cramp after unaccustomed exercise; the calf is soft and non-tender with no swelling or asymmetry.

diagnosis.esi2roomsNotes: ESI 5: no ED treatment-area resources are expected; brief evaluation, counseling, and discharge are appropriate.
diagnosis.disposition: Discharge → hydration, stretching, gradual progression of training
diagnosis.why: The job here is excluding DVT: no swelling, no tenderness, no calf asymmetry, and it resolved completely. Compare with case 076, which has all of those findings.

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 44-year-old woman in workout clothes, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting with one leg extended, absently rubbing her calf. Expression: slightly embarrassed, entirely comfortable now. Clearly visible: a hand rubbing the back of one calf; workout clothes and trainers. Overall: entirely well. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
